metadataReview: Every block runtime version read; metadata and target event definitions loaded separately per observed runtime before decoding. No cross-runtime portable-type equality assumed.

event.name: Burned
docs: Some amount was burned from an account.

event.name: NetworkAdded
docs: a new network is added.

event.name: NetworkRemoved
docs: a network is removed.

event.name: ColdkeySwapAnnounced

fields.name: who
docs: The account ID of the coldkey that made the announcement.

fields.name: new_coldkey_hash
docs: The hash of the new coldkey.
A coldkey swap announcement has been made.

event.name: ColdkeySwapReset

fields.name: who
docs: The account ID of the coldkey for which the swap has been reset.
A coldkey swap has been reset.

event.name: ColdkeySwapped

fields.name: old_coldkey
docs: The account ID of old coldkey.

fields.name: new_coldkey
docs: The account ID of new coldkey.
A coldkey has been swapped.

event.name: ColdkeySwapDisputed

fields.name: coldkey
docs: The account ID of the coldkey that was disputed.
A coldkey swap has been disputed.

event.name: SubnetIdentitySet
docs: The identity of a subnet has been set

event.name: SubnetIdentityRemoved
docs: The identity of a subnet has been removed

event.name: DissolveNetworkScheduled

fields.name: account
docs: The account ID schedule the dissolve network extrinsic

fields.name: netuid
docs: network ID will be dissolved

fields.name: execution_block
docs: extrinsic execution block number
A dissolve network extrinsic scheduled.

event.name: SubnetOwnerHotkeySet
docs: The owner hotkey for a subnet has been set.
Parameters:
(netuid, new_hotkey)

event.name: AlphaRecycled
docs: Alpha has been recycled, reducing AlphaOut on a subnet.
Parameters:
(coldkey, hotkey, amount, subnet_id)

event.name: AlphaBurned
docs: Alpha have been burned without reducing AlphaOut.
Parameters:
(coldkey, hotkey, amount, subnet_id)

event.name: AddStakeBurn

fields.name: netuid
docs: The subnet ID

fields.name: hotkey
docs: hotky account ID

fields.name: amount
docs: Tao provided

fields.name: alpha
docs: Alpha burned
"Add stake and burn" event: alpha token was purchased and burned.

event.name: NetworkDissolveCleanupCompleted

fields.name: netuid
docs: The subnet ID
data for a dissolved network has been cleaned up.

event.name: ColdkeySwapCleared

fields.name: who
docs: The account ID of the coldkey that cleared the announcement.
A coldkey swap announcement has been cleared.

event.name: SubnetOwnerChanged

fields.name: netuid
docs: The subnet whose owner changed.

fields.name: old_coldkey
docs: The previous owner coldkey.

fields.name: new_coldkey
docs: The new owner coldkey.
Subnet ownership was reassigned by lock conviction.

event.name: NetworkRegistrationQueued

fields.name: coldkey
docs: The network registration information.

fields.name: hotkey
docs: The hotkey that registered the network.

fields.name: mechid
docs: The mechanism that registered the network.

fields.name: identity
docs: The identity that registered the network.

fields.name: lock_amount
docs: The lock amount that registered the network.

fields.name: median_subnet_alpha_price
docs: The median subnet alpha price that registered the network.

fields.name: registration_block
docs: The block at which the network was registered.
A network registration cost has been queued.

event.name: NetworkRegistrationCancelled

fields.name: coldkey
docs: Registrant whose escrow was refunded or legacy lock released.

fields.name: hotkey
docs: Intended subnet owner hotkey.

fields.name: lock_id
docs: Identifier of the cancelled queue entry.

fields.name: error
docs: Settlement failure that triggered cancellation.
A queued registration failed terminally; its escrow was refunded or
its pre-upgrade balance lock was released. No subnet was created.

event.name: SubnetEmissionWeightsSet

fields.name: netuid
docs: Subnet whose vector changed.

fields.name: weights
docs: Full post-merge vector `[burn, recycle, owner, validator, miner]` in
`u64::MAX` parts.
The subnet owner or root set the subnet's emission weight vector.

event.name: GammaMinted

fields.name: netuid
docs: Subnet of the alpha and the gamma.

fields.name: coldkey
docs: Coldkey that burned the alpha and owns the deposit.

fields.name: hotkey
docs: Hotkey of the deposit credited.

fields.name: spender
docs: The deposit's spender.

fields.name: daily_spend_cap
docs: The deposit's daily spend cap.

fields.name: tao
docs: TAO taken from the coldkey's balance; zero when minting with stake.

fields.name: alpha
docs: Alpha burned.

fields.name: value
docs: TAO value of the alpha burned.

fields.name: gamma
docs: Gamma credited.
Gamma was minted for burned alpha.

event.name: GammaSpent

fields.name: netuid
docs: Subnet of the deposit.

fields.name: coldkey
docs: Coldkey owning the deposit.

fields.name: hotkey
docs: Hotkey of the deposit.

fields.name: spender
docs: The deposit's spender, which signed the spend.

fields.name: amount
docs: Gamma spent.

fields.name: reference
docs: The spend entry's reference.
Gamma was spent from a deposit and burned.

event.name: GammaSpendSkipped

fields.name: netuid
docs: Subnet of the spend.

fields.name: hotkey
docs: Hotkey of the entry.

fields.name: spender
docs: The spender that signed the spend.

fields.name: amount
docs: The entry's amount.

fields.name: reference
docs: The spend entry's reference.

fields.name: reason
docs: Why the entry was skipped.
A spend entry was skipped, and spent nothing.

event.name: SubnetGammaEmissionSet

fields.name: netuid
docs: Subnet whose split changed.

fields.name: shares
docs: `(target, share)` in `u64::MAX` parts, in ascending target order.
A subnet's gamma shares were set.

event.name: GammaEmissionMinted

fields.name: netuid
docs: Subnet whose emission paid for the gamma.

fields.name: target
docs: Subnet of the gamma.

fields.name: coldkey
docs: Coldkey that owns the deposit.

fields.name: hotkey
docs: Hotkey of the deposit credited.

fields.name: spender
docs: The deposit's spender.

fields.name: alpha_sold
docs: Alpha of `netuid` the sale took.

fields.name: tao
docs: TAO the sale returned and the purchase spent.

fields.name: alpha
docs: Alpha burned.

fields.name: value
docs: TAO value of the alpha burned.

fields.name: gamma
docs: Gamma credited.
A subnet's gamma share minted gamma on its target.

event.name: SubnetGammaEnabledSet

fields.name: netuid
docs: The network identifier.

fields.name: enabled
docs: Whether gamma minting is enabled on it.
Gamma minting was enabled or disabled on a subnet.

event.name: GammaEnabledSet

fields.name: enabled
docs: Whether gamma minting is enabled.
Gamma minting was enabled or disabled network-wide.
